Indicators of Compromise: MD5 hashes of malware artifacts; Domains used to distribute Quasar payloads; Password protected fake resume Microsoft Word documents; Large 401 MB Microsoft Self Extracting executable; Base64 encoded garbage code in macros; Payload URLs concealed in metadata
